by_window_NESTED_warning.note: 274/180/90 all end on the same final bar, so these are one observation at three scales, not three windows.

by_session_caveat: DEFECTS.md D3: Trade.session records the SIGNAL bar's session, not the fill's, and mismatches on 89.4% of 60m and 100% of 240m trades. These numbers are mislabelled by one bar and are reported for completeness only. Do not build a time-of-day rule on them.
by_regime_caveat: TREND_UP +0.054R against TREND_DOWN -0.070R over a sample in which the equity indices rose. That is a direction/sample artefact before it is a regime finding. DEFECTS.md D9 also applies at 240m on windows <=180d, where regime labels are largely UNKNOWN.
